name: artpi
description: Always-on Raspberry Pi web art display

scripts.pi:setup-cursor: scp pi/kiosk.sh jackrugile@artpi.local:~/artpi-kiosk.sh && scp pi/setup-cursor.sh jackrugile@artpi.local:~/artpi-setup-cursor.sh && ssh -t jackrugile@artpi.local 'chmod +x ~/artpi-kiosk.sh ~/artpi-setup-cursor.sh && bash ~/artpi-setup-cursor.sh'
scripts.pi:stop: ssh jackrugile@artpi.local 'pkill -f chromium || true; pkill -f chromium-browser || true'
scripts.pi:status: ssh jackrugile@artpi.local 'hostname; uptime; echo; pgrep -a chromium || pgrep -a chromium-browser || echo "chromium is not running"'
